summary: the relative difference between two values of the viscosity of water on one sheet

inputs.name: reference_viscosity
inputs.meaning: the value it is compared with

validity: two values of the same quantity in the same unit; it says how far apart they are and nothing about which is right

source.citation: by definition: the difference of two values over the one taken as the reference
source.locus: which row is the reference is the binding's choice, not a property of this skill

note: It holds no coefficient. Its grade is the worst of E4 and the two rows it compares.
